edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned as owner in the constructor, establishing the privileged role.
onlyOwner modifier gates setUniswapPool on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates stopBurningEmergency on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates enableBurningEmergency on msg.sender == owner.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of funds.
transferFrom spends the caller's allowance via _msgSender().
oneH is derived from block.timestamp, making the fee tier time dependent.
stopBurning is derived from block.timestamp, making emergency toggles time dependent.
calculateFee compares block.timestamp to oneH to pick the burn percentage.
stopBurningEmergency requires block.timestamp >= stopBurning.
enableBurningEmergency requires block.timestamp >= stopBurning.
setUniswapPool reads the hard-coded factory interface to create the pair.
setUniswapPool queries uniswap.WETH() to derive the paired token.
setUniswapPool triggers the external createPair call.
The external createPair return value is written directly into pool with no validation.
pool is compared with recipient to decide the burn fee branch.
_transfer checks whether sender or recipient equals pool to apply fees.
isBurning decides whether _transfer takes the burn branch or the plain branch.
stopBurningEmergency sets isBurning to false.
enableBurningEmergency sets isBurning to true.
stopBurningEmergency writes the isBurning state variable.
enableBurningEmergency writes the isBurning state variable.
triggered gates the pool-recipient fee branch inside calculateFee.
_transfer calls calculateFee to derive the burn amount.
_transfer sets triggered to true after the first pool transfer.
_transfer debits and credits the _balances mapping.
_transfer reads sender and recipient balances before mutating them.
_transfer invokes _burn when the pool is a counterparty.
transfer routes the caller-supplied transfer into the state-mutating _transfer routine.
transfer delegates all movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates movement to _transfer before updating allowance.
transferFrom reads and subtracts from the _allowances mapping.
_burn reduces the account balance in _balances.
_burn reduces _totalSupply by the burned amount.
The local ToBurn derived from calculateFee is passed to _burn, so an implicit zero skews supply.
The local ToTransfer is used for balance updates after subtracting the fee.
The missing terminal return in calculateFee produces an implicit zero fee amount.
Address.sendValue forwards value to a caller-influenced recipient, enabling reentrant callbacks on state changes.
calculateFee.recipient is compared against the pool address.
calculateFee.sender is compared against the pool address.
calculateFee.amount feeds the multiplication that can fall through to the implicit zero return.
_transfer.recipient is compared against pool to choose the fee path.
_transfer.sender is compared against pool to choose the fee path.
_transfer.amount is forwarded to calculateFee as the fee base.
_burn.account indexes the balance mapping that is decremented.
_burn.amount is subtracted from _totalSupply and the account balance.
transfer.recipient is forwarded to _transfer as the credited address.
transfer.amount is forwarded to _transfer as the movement amount.
transferFrom.sender is forwarded to _transfer as the debited address.
transferFrom.recipient is forwarded to _transfer as the credited address.
transferFrom.amount is subtracted from the recorded allowance.
transferFrom.amount is forwarded to _transfer as the movement amount.
